findings.reason: §3's premise is factually incomplete and its done-when is satisfiable while every dispatched worker keeps reading unextended, partly contradicting guidance from its own prompt.
findings.text: §3 asserts reckon-create "is the only place figures are currently described" and names two surfaces to extend, but the runtime worker prompt reaches every dispatched worker with the same figure guidance: `BRIEF_LANDING_CONTRACT` (line 203-205) and `PLAN_LANDING_CONTRACT` (line 166-169) tell a worker to place figures under `docs/figures/<topic>/` and, in the plan case, `docs/figures/<plan>/<node-id>/` — a sub-path, not the topic the §3 rule requires declaring. The landed commit 08e9f5b1 touched only `skills/reckon-create/SKILL.md` and `skills/reckon-build/references/worker-protocol.md`, so the surface that actually governs a capture node still states a figure path that contradicts the new allocation rule.

findings.reason: the rule landed in the right file, so this is a wording defect in §3 that a one-line correction fixes without altering the design.
findings.text: §3 names the second surface as "the ship references" and commit 08e9f5b1 records the path as `skills/reckon-ship/references/worker-protocol.md`, but no `reckon-ship` skill exists; the file the rule actually landed in is `skills/reckon-build/references/worker-protocol.md`. The rule is written correctly but the plan misnames the surface it extends, so a reader following §3 looks for a skill that is not there.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan adds no module; §2 pins the existing dispatch directory-claim machinery (`_directory_claim_overlaps`, `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2382`) behind the walk it already had rather than hiding new behaviour behind new surface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the allocation unit's owner is the dispatch directory-claim walk (`_directory_claim_overlaps` / `_scopes_overlap`, `reckon/crew/runs.py:693`), which the plan verifies and pins; no second placement or path-resolution path is forked.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1470, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; the plan adds no member to any of these families (§2's landed node changed no runtime code and introduced no new refusal kind), so there is no added surface to account for.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan searched two surfaces but missed `reckon/crew/prompts.py`, whose landing contracts carry figure-placement guidance into every worker prompt.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no wrapper is added; the plan explicitly declines to reimplement the containment guard and adds only tests plus a mechanism comment.
